name: blender
description: Blender Python, rigging, animation and asset export as of Blender 5.x: a stdlib checker for bpy calls the target version removed or renamed (action.fcurves, bone layers, bake_action keywords, driver_add modifiers, Geometry Nodes Socket_N keys); anim_audit.py, which runs the real FBX/glTF exporters and reports dropped, cross-assigned, duplicated or late clips and loop pops; rig_check.py for export-breaking rigs and skins; an in-Blender mesh QA script with UV-damage compare; and FBX/glTF export rules for Unreal, Unity and Godot.

cc_bpy_check.title: bpy removal check (CC_BPY_CHECK)
cc_bpy_check.description: Run check_bpy_scripts.py on a written .py that imports bpy, and add the removed or deprecated calls it finds: on or off. The environment variable CC_BPY_CHECK overrides this.
